# paperclip_permission_grants (Resource)

Manages all permission grants for a company member as a single owned set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "paperclip_permission_grants" "operator_grants" {
  company_id = paperclip_company.acme.id
  member_id  = paperclip_membership.operator.id
  grants = [
    {
      permission_key = "agents:create"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (String) Company identifier owning the member.
- `grants` (List of Objects, see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants)) The authoritative set of permission grants for this member.
- `member_id` (String) Member identifier owning the permission grants.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier formatted as <company_id>/<member_id>.

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

### Required

- `permission_key` (String) Permission key identifier.

### Optional

- `scope` (String) JSON-formatted structured scope constraints.
